title: TuxGuitar: free Guitar Pro alternative
caption:
Guitar Pro 8 costs $69.95. TuxGuitar writes and plays guitar tabs for free 🎸

✅ Write tabs next to regular sheet music
✅ Built-in player plays your song back
✅ Opens Guitar Pro, Power Tab, TablEdit and MIDI files
✅ Free, with no trial and no subscription

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux · Android
ℹ️ The interface looks a bit dated, and the installers aren't signed, so your system will warn you on first install. It also isn't a clone of Guitar Pro 8, so some of its features differ

Comment "GUITAR" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
